prompt: Long lens down a terrace of red-brick two-up two-down houses: every front door is open, the houses empty, and the pavement is lined both sides with the contents of the whole street, beds, wardrobes, washing machines, a woman in a dressing gown sitting in an armchair on the pavement looking at her house. Flat grey overcast winter daylight in a near-future Britain, muted cold colour, drizzle in the air; photographed like a feature film on 35mm stock: fine grain, deep shadows that stay dark, no lens flare, no bloom, no teal-orange grade. 16:9. No writing anywhere in the frame: no signs, banners, logos, number plates or screen text. No children.
